probe_finding: Definition (author @throwthedamball, read 2026-10-15): SYSTEM PLAY RATE — the share of a QB's plays that stay in structure: the QB goes to his initial look and his rhythm is not thrown off by the defense; charted with in-system grade/EPA. It is the complement of the disruption frame (C-309): system plays are the plays the offense's design actually got to run. Role in-engine: separates design-driven production from improvisation-driven production — two offenses with identical EPA can be built oppositely, and their fragility differs (a system offense breaks when the defense takes the first read; a create-heavy offense breaks differently). Read with C-311/C-312 as the author's three-state QB frame: in-system, created, destroyed.
